post.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Creates new attachments for an existing challenge with the provided files.
post.summary: [Author+] Creates new attachments for a challenge

parameters.description: the list of files to upload (at least one file is required)
parameters.name: files

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid multipart form` | `Invalid form data` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Attachments[i] must not exceed 128`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error creating attachments`

delete.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Deletes attachments for an existing challenge with the provided names.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Names[i] must not exceed 128`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching attachment` | `Error deleting attachment`

get.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Retrieves a list of all categories (with role **Player** only visible one are returned).

post.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Creates a new category with the provided name.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `Name must not exceed 32`

delete.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Deletes an existing category with the provided name.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `Name must not exceed 32`

patch.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Updates an existing category with the provided name (also updates its own challenges categories).

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `Name must not exceed 32` | `NewName must not exceed 32`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching category` | `Error creating category` | `Error updating category` | `Error deleting category`

get.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Retrieves a list of all challenges (with role **Player** only visible one are returned).

200.description: List of challenges with all dysplayable details (except solves)

post.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Creates a new challenge with the provided details.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `Name must not exceed 32` | `Category must not exceed 32` | `Description must not exceed 10240` | `Type must be one of: Normal Container Compose` | `MaxPoints must be at least 0` | `ScoreType must be one of: Static Dynamic`

delete.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Deletes a challenge with the provided ID.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0`

patch.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Updates an existing challenge with the provided fields, only the `chall_id` is required.
patch.summary: [Author+] Updates details of an existing challenge

parameters.description: `chall_id` is required, the rest of the fields are optional, only provide the fields you want to update
parameters.name: data

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `No data provided to update` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Name must not exceed 128` | `Category must not exceed 32` | `Description must not exceed 10240` | `Authors[i] must not exceed 64` | `Tags[i] must not exceed 32` | `Type must be one of: Normal Container Compose` | `MaxPoints must be at least 0` | `ScoreType must be one of: Static Dynamic` | `Port must be at least 0` | `Port must not exceed 65535` | `ConnType must be one of: NONE TCP HTTP HTTPS` | `Lifetime must be at least 0` | `Invalid environment variables` | `MaxMemory must be at least 0` | `Invalid Max CPU, must be a positive 32-bit integer`

404.description: Possible errors: `Challenge not found` | `Category not found`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error updating challenge`

get.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Retrieves challenge details (with role **Player** only solves if the challenge is visible).

200.description: solves is only included if the requester has Player role, otherwise all the challenge details are included except the solves

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid challenge ID, must be non negative` | `id must be at least 0`

parameters.description: a list of challenge IDs to toggle hidden status
parameters.name: data

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallIDs[i] must be at least 0`

get.description:
Requires **Author** privileges or higher.
Retrieves a list of all instances.

post.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Creates a new instance of a challenge for a team (if **Player**, only visible challenges).
Note: This endpoint uses docker, so it's critical, remember that all 500 errors will log the full error message.
post.summary: [Player+] Spawns a new instance of a challenge

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Challenge is not instanciable` | `Invalid image`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error fetching instance` | `Error creating instance`

delete.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Deletes an instance of a challenge for a team (if **Player**, only visible challenges), with **Admin** role is also possible to delete instances for other teams.
Note: This endpoint uses docker, so it's critical, remember that all 500 errors will log the full error message.
delete.summary: [Player+] Deletes an instance of a challenge

parameters.description: `chall_id` is required, `team_id` is optional and only for admins
parameters.name: data

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `TeamID must be at least 0` | `Challenge is not instanciable`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error fetching instance` | `Error deleting instance`

patch.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Updates the lifetime of an existing instance of a challenge for a team (if **Player**, only visible challenges).
patch.summary: [Player+] Updates the lifetime of an existing instance of a challenge

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Challenge is not instanciable`

404.description: Possible errors: `Challenge not found` | `Instance not found`

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error fetching instance` | `global lifetime is missing` | `Error updating instance`

post.description:
Requires **Player** privileges or higher (with role **Player** is also required to be in a team and the competition has to be active).
Creates submission for a challenge for the player's team (if **Player**, only on visible challenges).
If **Author** role or higher the submission is not created the flag is only validated.
If the discord webhook is configured and the submission is a first blood, a message will be sent to the discord channel.
post.summary: [Player+] Create a new submission for a challenge

200.description: Submission status and if it's a first blood

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `ChallID must be at least 0` | `Flag must not exceed 256 `

500.description: Possible errors: `Error fetching challenge` | `Error submitting flag`

delete.description:
Requires **Admin** privileges.
Deletes a submission specified by the submission ID.

400.description: Possible errors: `Invalid JSON format` | `Missing required fields` | `SubID must be at least 0`
